bug_semantics: The unauthenticated Genkit developer Tools server accepted action-execution requests while listening beyond a loopback-only trust boundary and did not validate the HTTP Host header. CORS only controls which origins receive browser-readable response headers; it does not stop the handler, and a DNS-rebound page retains its attacker origin while resolving its hostname to the developer machine. Consequently a LAN client or DNS-rebound browser could reach the action runner, supply an action key and input (later also context), execute any registered flow/tool/model/prompt, and read the returned result. The reported chain also used the telemetry SSE endpoint's wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin to read trace inputs and outputs.
flaw_origin: The earliest persisted tree that makes the network-listening Runner API actually execute actions is squash aggregate 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f: it adds genkit-tools/src/runner/router.ts with a runAction mutation that proxies to the reflection server and changes genkit-tools/src/runner/runner.ts to expose that router through api.listen(port) without a host argument or Host validation. Its parent 805600159f34ca96d95c26c10c7b2799cb5951ce already had the all-interface Express listener but only stubbed, NOT_IMPLEMENTED flow operations, so it lacked the action-execution primitive. The squash message lists many member commits, including the causally relevant 'Implemented passthrough endpoints in Runner API', but that member commit object and SHA are not retained in the validated clone or associated public PR history; therefore the protocol's smallest non-aggregate BIC cannot be named.
ai_marker: unavailable: the true BIC is the inaccessible member commit inside squash aggregate 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f that first implemented the Runner API passthrough. Because that member's commit object is absent, its author, committer, Co-Authored-By/Generated-with trailers, and bot status cannot be checked; the aggregate commit object is deliberately not substituted for BIC-only AI attribution.
evidence: First-party report https://github.com/genkit-ai/genkit/issues/5581 documents the live Genkit CLI 1.36.0 PoC: a request with Host: attacker.evil.com to POST /api/runAction executed a registered flow and returned an X-Genkit-Trace-Id, then the telemetry SSE endpoint returned the trace with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. git log --follow and git log -SrunAction trace the same action-execution primitive from 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f through the 64c94c0bbcc86db000e821bc7b18264057641315 server consolidation, the 61129e141c3257e374f8c48eb1de6a5cad4c3096 tools-common move, and the 978e3ddae0d0e527b2521aeaa9ee8e18a429c7dd conversion from tRPC runAction to explicit POST /api/runAction; those later commits preserve/re-express the capability rather than originate it. git diff 805600159f34ca96d95c26c10c7b2799cb5951ce..91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f shows genkit-tools/src/runner/router.ts added, while git show of the parent shows only NOT_IMPLEMENTED flows/runFlow/reload procedures behind app.listen(PORT); thus the vulnerable functional route is absent from the aggregate's immediate parent. The aggregate commit message enumerates 27 squash members and identifies 'Implemented passthrough endpoints in Runner API' as the causal step, but GitHub's commit-to-pulls endpoint returns no associated PR, current PR #3 is unrelated, the validated clone's unreachable commit objects contain no matching member, and the author's historical fork is unavailable. Version membership: the earliest tag containing the aggregate is 0.5.0-rc.9 at 2edaaab625eb2274f182421ef13f5464f20df982, followed by 0.5.0; this is consistent with the CVE range 'affected from 0'. The last tools release before the landed mitigation is @genkit-ai/tools-common@1.39.0/genkit-cli@1.39.0 at 54c60aab1c89844e0ba6231f46f9a13241e6368c. Commit 66bfbbc5198db40e236d61760ea5ab2b34aac75c landed 2026-07-16 and is first released in @genkit-ai/tools-common@1.40.0/genkit-cli@1.40.0 at c85153e04c766300fa2fdd755393076657f2a216; its diff binds the Tools, telemetry, and reflection servers to 127.0.0.1 but adds no Host validation. The advisory-linked https://github.com/genkit-ai/genkit/pull/5587 remains open; its direct tools commit fb00011b5aade16638c9f6b72502e2085d94ca51 adds rejectNonLoopbackHost, loopback binding, and removes telemetry SSE wildcard CORS, while 34ec0a6ca0bfc7b2caedd7524939779556317da0 covers reflection. Current main still has no rejectNonLoopbackHost middleware and retains the telemetry SSE wildcard, so no complete merged fix SHA exists despite the CVE record's calendar claim that the issue was fixed on 2026-06-18.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first tracing distinguishes the pre-existing network listener from the dangerous operation. Parent 805600159f34ca96d95c26c10c7b2799cb5951ce was reachable on all interfaces but its flow procedures deliberately threw NOT_IMPLEMENTED; aggregate 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f is the first persisted tree where an unauthenticated request can invoke the reflection server's action runner and obtain the result. Subsequent packaging moves and the 2025 explicit Express POST preserve that mechanism, while the 2026 localhost-CORS change cannot authorize requests and therefore does not remove DNS rebinding. The version graph places the origin before the first 0.5 release and the partial loopback mitigation only in 1.40.0, not at the CVE's claimed 2026-06-18 boundary. A complete Host-header/CORS patch is visible only on the still-open remediation PR. Most importantly for attribution, 91ed3de52e7db92943886526395ad8eac6faa77f is a squash aggregate and the audit protocol forbids treating it as the BIC. Its message makes the smaller causal member identifiable by subject, but neither its SHA nor its commit object is public/recoverable, so immediate-parent verification and commit-object AI inspection cannot be performed on the true BIC. That is a genuine public-history boundary, requiring BLOCKED rather than an AI or NOT_AI verdict.
remaining_gap: The missing fact is the full 40-hex SHA, immediate parent, and commit object of the squash member named 'Implemented passthrough endpoints in Runner API' (or an earlier member if its tree already contained the final functional runAction path). Without that retained member history, the smallest BIC's parent-tree absence and BIC-only AI markers cannot be verified. Separately, the complete Host-validation patch is still unmerged: 66bfbbc5198db40e236d61760ea5ab2b34aac75c is only a released loopback-binding mitigation, while fb00011b5aade16638c9f6b72502e2085d94ca51 is the direct but unmerged Tools/telemetry fix, so fix_sha is null.
